reviewItem.question: Does "Fixed DestinationRules on same host but with different ExportTo can behave inconsistently, so stop merging the destinationRules when the exportTo attributes…" mean a change to env-var:istio|name=ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Istio pilot no longer merges DestinationRules for the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different; setting ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment restores the old merging.
